non_blocking_items.description: V1 preserves authoritative risk rejection for a terminal settlement EXIT and keeps the settlement barrier closed; retry, replacement, and operational resolution require a later approved product iteration.
A terminal Trade Plan without an authoritative execution receipt cannot materialize an immutable outcome in V1; it fails closed instead of accepting caller-supplied position or PnL values.

A durable execution claim without a completed receipt has unknown financial disposition and blocks the affected order and portfolio until operations reconcile authoritative evidence; claims never expire, transfer, or retry blindly.
non_blocking_items.target_phase: Approved operational reconciliation before execution resume
